rulings.Calendar Matter: Notice Of Motion And Motion To Compel Further Responses To Special Interrogatories, Set One, To Defendant City And County Of San Francisco
rulings.Rulings: Matter on the LAW AND MOTION / DISCOVERY Calendar for Friday, Sep-11-2026. LINE 3. 1-PLAINTIFF NIKCOLE CUNNINGHAM's Motion To Compel Further Responses To Special Interrogatories, Set One, To Defendant City And County Of San Francisco. Plaintiff Nikcole Cunningham's motion to compel further responses to her special interrogatories, set one, is granted. The City and County of San Francisco shall make verified, Code-compliant responses within 10 days of notice of entry of this order. The City does not attempt to defend the merits of its responses but instead argues that Cunningham should have granted it extensions in light of counsel's trial schedule. Extensions are often granted as a courtesy, but a party is not required to give them, and the Code supplies the applicable deadlines for compliant responses in the absence of an extension. The City has not cured since the motion was filed. No party seeks sanctions on this motion, but the court gives notice to both parties that it will consider sanctions sua sponte on future discovery motions against a party whose discovery position lacks substantial justification.
